request.style: English, female solo voice with warm choir, acoustic guitar, fiddle, bodhran, piano, cello, gentle and hopeful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Justified by faith we stand today
Peace with God is our new way
Through Christ our Lord the path is clear
We have access to draw near

[Chorus]
We boast in the hope of glory
God's love is our story
Peace with God through Jesus
In grace we rest and trust you

[Verse]
Suffering brings endurance true
Character grows from trials through
Hope remains and will not fail
God's love fills our hearts with mail

[Chorus]
We boast in the hope of glory
God's love is our story
Peace with God through Jesus
In grace we rest and trust you

[Bridge]
The Spirit pours love deep inside
We are justified and abide
No shame can take what is ours
Hope in His power and His powers

[Chorus]
We boast in the hope of glory
God's love is our story
Peace with God through Jesus
In grace we rest and trust you

[Outro]
Peace with God through Jesus
In grace we rest and trust you
